answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity to staked collateral that grows with proven work. Each agent locks a deposit before it can earn; its reputation becomes an opal ledger of completed, verified tasks, and bad behavior burns the stake. New identities start as a tiny island of trust with low limits, earning higher caps only through a long history of honest completions. A haven for cheaters would need to fund thousands of deposits and outspend the honest majority, so the attack costs far more than any payout it could steal.
